senses.gloss: f. (גדר, נ inserted; cmp. preced. art.) balustrade, ledge.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 70a:14">Kidd. 70ᵃ</cite> <he>פורתא דג׳ וכ׳</he> (Ar. by cler. error … <he>זנא</he>) I am only making a little bit of a balustrade (a word considered too affected in place of b. h. <cite ref="M02164"><he>מעקה</he></cite>, Talmudic <cite ref="M00872"><he>מחיצה</he></cite>).
